name: Dispersion
overview: The biblical account of Dispersion begins with the descendants of Noah who, unified by one language, settled in the plain of Shinar and endeavored to build a city and a tower reaching to heaven. Their intention to make a name for themselves and avoid being scattered is directly confronted by the Lord, who observes their unity and decides to confuse their language to restrain their plans. This event marks the origin of the dispersion of peoples across the earth, illustrating God's sovereign intervention to fulfill His purpose. The topic also encompasses the foretold dispersion of the Jews, linking this foundational moment to later biblical history.
